review:
A 5x5 heist where multiplier wilds multiply each other on a line – x2 up to x25 – instead of adding. They have a second job too: when a Grab 'Em symbol lands, every cash symbol in the 3x3 around a multiplier gets that multiplier.

Multipliers of x4 and above land as question marks and only reveal when cash is collected, so there's always a moment of suspense. Two bonus modes build on the collect system. 10,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
